highlights: Gizmo All: one gizmo with move, rotate and scale handles at once, on Shift+W (thanks fenix on Discord, @fenixpoints)
Cut with symmetry cuts both sides alike, and Blender keys get Ctrl+Shift cut shapes and Alt+Q to pick a Part (thanks dm4nd on Discord)
Split can keep the original: copy hidden, masked or unmasked areas into a new Part and leave the source as it is (thanks _tfx on Discord)

Tool > Geometry is reorganised by task (Levels, Micro Detail, Resolution, Cleanup, Symmetry) with clearer names, Extract reads Thickness, Edge Smooth, Both Sides, Corners and Border, and popups are fully opaque
macOS: SculptForge > Preferences... in the app menu opens Preferences (thanks @fenixpoints)
